I.value_en: ADR-0015..0022, existing spec, pyproject, historical 0.7.x spec, and FCoP v1.0 document context.
I.notes_en: No external repository is read or modified.

O.value_en: Seven JSON Schemas, schemas README, one v1.0 long-form spec, pyproject dependency entry, REPORT-003, and task archive record.
O.notes_zh: 不含 Python 实现或测试。
O.notes_en: Python implementation and tests are excluded.

A.value_zh: 按两次提交生成 schema、README、长篇规范、依赖项、报告和归档。
A.value_en: Produce schemas, README, long-form specification, dependency entry, report, and archive in two commits.
A.notes_zh: 任务动作不构成执行授权。
A.notes_en: Task actions are not execution authorization.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 发起任务，ME 独立执行。

R.value_en: Specification about 600 lines, each schema about 80 lines, two commits.

V.value_en: ADR-0015..0022, JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, RFC-2119, ADR-0003.

C.value_zh: A1–A8：八文件、JSON 有效、元数据/ADR 追溯、九节规范、RFC 语言和链接、依赖项、报告归档提交推送。
C.value_en: A1–A8: eight files, valid JSON, metadata/ADR traceability, nine-section spec, RFC language/links, dependency, report/archive/commit/push.

B.value_zh: 不得触碰 src/fcop、dataclass、validator、Project 方法、pytest、CLI、migration、Issue 回复或 mcp；不得删历史 spec；不得对 envelope root 设 additionalProperties:false；不得超过 800 行规范。
B.value_en: Do not touch src/fcop, dataclasses, validator, Project methods, pytest, CLI, migration, Issue reply, or mcp; do not delete historical spec; do not set additionalProperties:false on envelope root; do not exceed 800-line spec.
